subject: maths
question: What sum will become ₹9,826 in 18 months if the rate of interest is 2(1)/(2)\% per annum and the interest is compound half- yearly?
solution:
Given:

Amount = Rs.9826

Time = 18 months 

Rate = 5/2% Per annum 

Formulas used:

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal 

Amount = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Calculation:

Time period = 3/2 × 2 = 3

Rate as per half- yearly basis = (5/2)/2 = (5/4)% 

9826 = P × [1 + (5/4)/100]³

⇒ P = 9826 × (400/405)³

⇒ P = 9466.55

∴ The sum is Rs. 9466.55
